Honda Prelude Adds the Fancy Bordeaux Edition to the Lineup in Australia, Starting From $45k
11 photos
Photo: Honda
The Japanese automaker Honda has introduced a new special edition to its lineup in the Land Down Under, the cool-looking Honda Prelude Bordeaux Edition, which costs AU $67,000 driveaway, or about $45k at the current exchange rates.
The Asian carmaker is taking good care of its Australian market and announced quite a few novelties recently: it partnered with artist Kentaro Yoshida on a custom Honda Super-ONE for a set of fresh decals with a unique visual style by the acclaimed Japanese artist and illustrator; announced “the first vehicle of a new generation, (…) pointing to its future direction for design and innovation” with the all-new Honda Avancier ; revealed that its next-generation hybrid system will be called ‘Honda Hybrid,’ and more.
They also announced for both the Honda and Acura brands a massive 636k vehicle recall procedure to address an error with the Driver Attention Monitor road-condition compensation calculation, which can leave drivers without power steering assistance in case of a mishap, so it’s not all just roses and daffodils. Anyway, Honda Prelude fans, at least the ones living in Europe and in Australia, won’t complain much about issues because they’ll be rather busy pampering their new special edition vehicles.
Back in late September 2026, Honda announced a new Prelude Limited Edition – that’s the name, no fancy titles on these occasions – available across the Old Continent starting this fall season for the 2027 model year, and it was wearing a decidedly special hue mix. The red-on-red aesthetic is the Premium Crystal Garnet Metallic combined with a Bordeaux interior. Now, Australian fans don’t need to envy their European peer anymore.
That’s because the local division of Honda announced today, November 16, 2026, the introduction of a new Bordeaux Edition Prelude as a “striking new addition to the Prelude line-up following the model’s return earlier this year.” You guessed correctly: it’s also finished in Premium Crystal Garnet Red on the outside and features a “distinctive heritage-inspired interior,” so the Bordeaux Edition mirrors the model seen just a few weeks ago in Europe. We really hope that America is coming next because the Prelude looks great in this color combination.
Honda Australia welcomed the return of the iconic Prelude nameplate earlier this year, and the new Bordeaux Edition will try to make it a collectible, too, not just another cool sports car. So, aside from its bespoke Premium Crystal Garnet Metallic exterior, the new special edition also includes front and rear crimson accents, a front upper grille in the body color, red Brembo x Prelude brake calipers, and 19-inch black cut alloy wheels. Inside, the Bordeaux edition features exactly the name’s color, of course.
Additionally, the 2027 Honda Prelude gets a Black X Blue interior trim for the Black model and also a Red exterior color. Otherwise, it’s the same as before, sporting the new S+ Shift technology that helps simulate the sound and feel of rapid automatic gear changes – including “a ‘kick’ and rev-matching throttle ‘blip’ felt during gear changes and engine braking.” The powertrain of the sixth-gen Prelude is a 2.0-liter hybrid with 200 hp combined and a single-speed direct-drive transmission setup.
